ablation.interpretation: a group whose 'only:' score is near the all-groups score carries most of the signal; a group whose 'without:' score is near the all-groups score adds little. Differences are on the same folds, so they are paired comparisons, but they are not independent tests: no p-value is claimed here
ablation.protocol: same folds, same files, same model settings as the main cross-validation; only the feature columns change
ablation.tuning: declared hyperparameters, no nested search: a feature-subset difference must not be confounded by tuning noise, and 21 variants x a search budget would dominate the run

gate_G7.reason: 95% intervals do not overlap and Model A is higher

deep.architecture: stem(strided conv) -> residual dilated conv blocks -> GAP -> linear
deep.fusion_explanation: probability blend and stacked head, both reported
notes: 60 of 135 files produced no usable event window; Model B does not score them and the hybrid falls back to Model A for those files
label-noise rate (files with zero usable events): 0.444
deep.representation_learning: supervised contrastive auxiliary loss on the GAP embedding

design_notes.aggregation: window -> file by mean_proba, declared before evaluation
design_notes.bootstrap: file-level only; a hierarchical bootstrap needs replicate groups
design_notes.class_weighting: none (imbalance below the design threshold of 1.5)
design_notes.hybrid_combination: fixed convex blend, Model A weight 0.5
design_notes.imputation: median, fitted within each training fold
design_notes.representation_flow: one 1D ConvNet encoder is fitted per outer fold; its global-average-pooled embedding is the single learned representation of the run and is consumed by (1) the softmax head -> cnn1d, (2) the nearest-prototype head -> proto_cnn, (3) the per-fold linear fusion head on handcrafted features + mean embedding -> fusion, (4) the probability blend with the best Model A -> hybrid, and (5) the conditional analyses: few-shot prototypes, semi-supervised pseudo-labels, novelty detection, clustering, and the file-level explanation map. Nothing downstream re-learns a representation, and no strategy is evaluated on files that contributed to the encoder, the prototypes, the fusion head, or the scaler.
design_notes.split_unit: file (each file is its own group; no replicate or session metadata)
design_notes.tuning: logreg C chosen by inner grouped CV within each outer training fold; the CNN early-stops and temperature-scales on a validation split carved from the outer training fold by file group
design_notes.window_scaling: robust median/IQR fitted on each fold's training windows only

definitions.cohens_kappa: chance-corrected agreement (sklearn cohen_kappa_score); empty when the prediction set is degenerate
definitions.ece: sum_b (n_b/n)|acc_b - conf_b| over equal-width bins of the max probability
definitions.mcc_multiclass: Matthews correlation from the multiclass confusion matrix
definitions.mce: max_b |acc_b - conf_b| over the same bins
definitions.pr_auc_ovr: one-vs-rest average precision; None when the class is absent or universal
definitions.precision_macro/recall_macro/f1_macro: unweighted mean of the per-class scores
definitions.precision_micro/recall_micro/f1_micro: multiclass micro averages; identical to accuracy
definitions.specificity: TN/(TN+FP) one-vs-rest; None when the subset holds no negative file
definitions.topk_accuracy: fraction of files whose true label is among the k largest probabilities

feature_redundancy.policy: flagged pairs are reported in feature_redundancy.csv and never dropped: dropping columns on the pooled matrix would use test-fold information

descriptions.acf: normalised autocorrelation of the residual at the configured lags
descriptions.amp: amplitude domain: RMS, peak, peak-to-peak, crest factor, percentiles, dynamic range
descriptions.ctx: context: inter-event intervals, burstiness, onset distribution, rate drift, amplitude-duration coupling, baseline stability, reference level
descriptions.event: event statistics: count, rate, duration, dip depth, amplitude
descriptions.morph: morphology: turning points, event rise/fall, area-to-peak, sharpness, self-similarity to this recording's mean event waveform
descriptions.noise: robust residual sigma, raw level and spread
descriptions.shape: distribution shape: skewness, excess kurtosis, tail fraction
descriptions.spec: frequency domain: Welch band powers, slope, peak, centroid, spread, entropy, roll-off, harmonicity
descriptions.tf: time-frequency: STFT flux, per-band energy drift, frame entropy, db2 wavelet levels
descriptions.time: temporal pattern: zero crossings, Hjorth, line length, Teager energy, permutation entropy, segment variability, drift

hpo.objective: mean inner grouped score inside each outer training fold; the outer test fold never influences the setting used to predict it
hpo.reason: training.hpo is 'none': logreg C comes from its exact grid over training.lr_c_grid inside each training fold, and rf/hgb keep the declared n_estimators and max_iter; deep.hpo_trials is 0, so Model B keeps its declared learning rate, dropout and weight decay (each trial would be a full training run, so the budget is the user's decision)
